coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with four advisories. Twenty-two attacks run, none landed. Seven of seven cited digests reproduce. Every quoted string reproduces character-exact from its source. Seven register cells. Both NT class names, inputs and pass properties — carried twice each, once in liveNtVerbatim and once inside the class objects, with both copies equal to preview-analyze-contract.v2's negativeTests, so the drift that two copies invite did not happen. The pack name and the pack rule against v2's own /pack members. The hardest thing in this file is the NT numbering, and it is where I expected to find the defect: DR-131 and DR-133 both number NT classes and the numbers collide, eight DR-131 classes are spread across six coordinator decisions and five gate rows, and two of this gate's three members come from a single disjunctive class. I resolved all eight routings twice, against the live gate row that owns each class and against the entry that created it, and every one matches: NT-1 and NT-2 at G24 by D-150, NT-3 at G25 by D-151, NT-4 discharged at D-148, NT-5 at G26 by D-152, NT-6 at G27 by D-153, NT-7 and NT-8 at G28 by D-154. The DR-133 sequence is kept apart structurally rather than positionally, by a liveDr131LeftoverNaming block keyed to its row and by writing '(DR-133 NT-3, NT-5)' wherever the other sequence appears. No NT number is invented; the NT-1a and NT-1b that a two-limb split would tempt are refused by name, and the two limbs travel as 'NT-1 first limb' and 'NT-1 second limb'. Two further probes failed to land. EV-1's definition of 'before evaluation' — no policyOutcome evaluation, no facts or Coverage consumption, no semantic-universe construction — is built entirely from v2's own vocabulary rather than invented, which I checked term by term in v2's bytes. And the missing platform matrix is correct rather than a gap: this gate's live cell carries no platform axis, unlike G07, G18 and G20, and the candidate records that platforms are not live-cell members instead of importing a four-platform matrix from its siblings. Importing one would have been the invention. Four advisories, none blocking. OBL-G24-HARNESS-SPEC is coined here with no creating join and a gate-row home — the fourth gate in that position after G07, G18 and G20, which is now settled enough to deserve one disposition covering all four. A bare gates2and3Hold: false sits directly beside a recorded D-154 standing that gates 2 and 3 DO hold for DR-131's eight NT classes; both are true of different subjects and the adjacency is deliberate, but the flag names no subject. executesVerbatim carries the live harness-cell corpus where the siblings carry a naming-v6 string, because naming v6 predates D-150 and does not name this identifier — which the candidate discloses rather than papering over. And namedCorpusClasses holds two objects sharing one memberVerbatim, which reads as two corpus classes against the single-entry field that exists to deny exactly that. This ACCEPT does not close OBL-G24-HARNESS-SPEC; that additionally requires your recording.
